notes: Research: the thesis/antithesis/synthesis triad is Fichte (1794), popularised for Hegel by Chalybaus (1837); Hegel himself used abstract/negative/concrete and Aufhebung (sublation: cancel, preserve, lift). Slots force: a steelmanned orthodoxy as its proponents state it; the critique as actually stated; the supporting points for each; the precise contested proposition once slogans are removed (often a shared hidden assumption, or the two sides answering different questions, which is how the method dismantles false dichotomies); a higher-order position that keeps what is true in both, not a split-the-difference compromise. Business textbook form: Mason (1969) and Mason and Mitroff (1981) dialectical inquiry (plan vs counterplan on opposite assumptions), and Martin (2007) integrative thinking. Common misuse: strawmanning one side so the synthesis is the author original view; synthesis as compromise; inventing a tension neither side holds; assuming every conflict has a synthesis. Classic example chosen: the rationalist vs empiricist debate on the source of knowledge, the standard history-of-philosophy case whose synthesis is Kant (1781); the scenario text stops before Kant so tension and synthesis are derived. Scout launched with Part B plus a short framework-specific addendum (what a live two-sided disagreement looks like, line numbers per quote, scratchpad path). Resumed after a rate-limit kill: research kept, scout relaunched (the first scout's output was lost). Scout returned three candidates; chose #1, the 2025-08-15 staged Slop-vs-Steel debate between Everett Randle (Kleiner Perkins) and Delian Asparouhov (Founders Fund), because it is the only one where both positions are stated by their own holders with reasons and each rebuts the other by name, so thesis and antithesis are both fact nodes rather than one speaker's characterisation of an absent opponent. Rejected #2 (Randle vs Kupor on fund size: the thesis is only voiced by a host steelmanning it) and #3 (LeCun scaling debate: poor diarisation, one side is reported rather than argued). Design decisions: kept the five registry slots and did not add a 'side' slot - which side an argument serves is carried by the argues_for edge and by left/right position in the plane layout. The TBPN example makes the show's own on-air framing a FACT tension node (t0) and puts the derived tensions (t1, t2) underneath it, so the graph demonstrates the framework's actual move: the stated dichotomy is the thing the derivation dismantles. idea_bearing_slot is synthesis, with an idea on both sy1 and sy2. One derived argument node (aa6) steelmans a reply the antithesis never states, at confidence 0.55, because the method requires each side to be given its best form. validate: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
